name: s3-keychain-spike
description: S3 spike: @napi-rs/keyring in a tsup bundle (Windows/Linux measurements). Dummy values only.

scripts.pack: npm run build && node -e "const f=require('fs');f.mkdirSync('pkg/dist',{recursive:true});f.copyFileSync('dist/cli.js','pkg/dist/cli.js')" && cd pkg && npm pack --pack-destination ..
scripts.build:sea: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --alias:@napi-rs/keyring=./src/keyring-sea.ts --outfile=sea/cli.cjs && node --experimental-sea-config sea/sea-config.json && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync(process.execPath,'sea/prosegate-spike.exe')" && postject sea/prosegate-spike.exe NODE_SEA_BLOB sea/sea-prep.blob --sentinel-fuse NODE_SEA_FUSE_fce680ab2cc467b6e072b8b5df1996b2
